status: Frozen before downloading or reading new reference raster values
support: 100m blocks, arithmetic linear-power mean before dB, >=80% valid radar/optical support, >=90% clear Landsat support
target: Exposed surface water fraction >=60% positive, clear dry fraction >=90% negative; ambiguous omitted
spatial_split: Train west half of fixed AOI, test east half, with 1km total easting gap (500m each side of midpoint). No reverse split.
model: Fixed L2 logistic regression, coefficient penalty 0.01, balanced training weights, training-only standardization; no tuning
uncertainty: 2000 paired 5km tile bootstrap samples with frozen models, 95% intervals; temporal/domain uncertainty excluded
decision: Incremental benefit requires positive gain in BOTH ROC AUC and average precision with both intervals excluding zero; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Abort numerical fit if either training or test lacks a class.
scope: New pre-specified evaluation within an already studied event; no new event confirmation or verified below-canopy labels. Historical data delivery remains unverified.
